over_inference.quote: A observations: "All five timeframes trend_20 negative; MTF agreement AGREE" + context L6 note: "timeframes are reported separately and are NEVER merged into one direction (§15)"
over_inference.finding: A merges per-timeframe trend statistics into a single 'uniform downtrend' and cites the L6 'AGREE' flag as support, directly contrary to the context's explicit contract that timeframes are never merged into one direction. The aggregation into a directional consensus is an over-inference beyond what the data contract allows.

over_inference.quote: A Q5: "Compression breakout direction: not entitled to assert which way" vs primary_scenario "DIRECTIONAL", direction_bias "DOWN"
over_inference.finding: Internal contradiction: the forecast explicitly disclaims entitlement to assert breakout direction, yet commits to a DIRECTIONAL down scenario with direction_bias DOWN. The analogs (A16307/A23475) show only BREAKOUT_ATTEMPT state transitions, never direction; mapping breakout-attempt to 'down continuation' is over-inference.

over_inference.quote: A observation: "H4 recent bars strongly bearish; trend_20 -82.76" while A's own what_i_do_not_know states "H4 current bar close 4315 implies data past as_of; excluded"
over_inference.finding: The H4 trend_20 (-82.76) is computed on the very current H4 bar whose close (4315.045) A itself excludes as post-as_of future data. Citing that contaminated statistic as 'strongly bearish' observation while excluding its source bar is inconsistent and overstates the bearish case.

mechanism_jump.quote: A evidence: "Compression after rejection favors prior direction continuation"
mechanism_jump.finding: Stated in the evidence list as if established, while possible_mechanisms caps trend_continuation at POSSIBLE. The 'favors' phrasing converts an unconfirmed mechanism into a directional weighting factor without a status transition or supporting measurement.

mechanism_jump.quote: A possible_mechanisms trend_continuation: "Down momentum; compression likely resolves with continuation"
mechanism_jump.finding: The 'why' asserts how compression will resolve ('with continuation', i.e., down). At PIT, breakout direction from compression is explicitly unresolved (A's own Q5); the mechanism status is honest (POSSIBLE) but the rationale smuggles in a directional assertion.

missing_counter_evidence.quote: Context current bars at timestamp 2026-08-14 00:00:00+00:00: M5 close 4348.375, M15 close 4360.325, H1 high 4364.005 / close 4356.035, H4 close 4315.045 — vs M1 close 4353.195
missing_counter_evidence.finding: All current bars above M1 embed post-as_of price action (M5 low 4348.065 / close 4348.375 differs from the simultaneous M1 close 4353.195; M15/H1/H4 highs and closes exceed anything in the completed M1 bar). A's primary down evidence rests on these contaminated statistics, and A never checked its own evidence for this contamination — it only excluded the single most extreme value (H4 close) while still using H4 trend_20.

missing_counter_evidence.quote: A evidence: "Analogs: 2 of 3 show BREAKOUT_ATTEMPT by step 4"
missing_counter_evidence.finding: Listed as supporting a breakout, but never listed as counter-evidence that the analogs contain NO direction information (state evolution only, per context note 'STATE EVOLUTION ONLY; no returns/PnL/labels ever included'). The breakout could equally resolve up; A's Q5 admits this but the evidence list still frames analogs as leaning its down view.

unjustified_confidence.quote: A Q7: "False: sufficient directional evidence despite missing macro data" + confidence 0.52, evidence_strength 0.5, uncertainty 0.44
unjustified_confidence.finding: The 'sufficient directional evidence' claim rests on trend statistics that are future-contaminated at 4 of 5 timeframes, on a direction A says it is 'not entitled to assert' (Q5), and on 0.375 ambiguity. A 0.52 confidence (near coin-flip) is not justified for committing to a directional scenario; the confidence number is not derivable from the stated evidence.

The three quantities have no defined relationship (0.5 + 0.44 != 1; confidence != 1 - uncertainty) and no calibration basis; confidence_reason repeats the same contaminated 'uniform down trends' claim rather than accounting for the strength of counter-evidence it itself listed (DXY, bounces, A30857, ambiguity 0.375).

observation_as_fact.quote: A observation: "All five timeframes trend_20 negative; MTF agreement AGREE"
observation_as_fact.finding: Treated as a neutral observed fact of a 'uniform downtrend', but it is a selection of derived statistics that (a) omits H4 trend_50 +256.38 and (b) includes 4 of 5 values computed from current bars containing post-as_of prices. A derived, incomplete, contaminated statistic is presented as an observed fact.

observation_as_fact.quote: A observation: "H4 recent bars strongly bearish; trend_20 -82.76"
observation_as_fact.finding: The -82.76 comes almost entirely from the current H4 bar's future close (4315.045 vs prior close 4353.645); presenting this as an observation of recent bar behaviour converts a look-ahead artifact into a stated market fact.

strongest_objection: A's directional case is built on evidence it simultaneously disqualifies. The headline observation and evidence item 'All five timeframes trend_20 negative' depends on current M5/M15/H1/H4 bars whose closes, highs and lows (M5 close 4348.375 vs simultaneous M1 close 4353.195; M15 close 4360.325; H1 high 4364.005; H4 close 4315.045) embed price action after as_of 00:00 — the same reason A gives for excluding the H4 close in what_i_do_not_know ('H4 current bar close 4315 implies data past as_of; excluded'). A cannot exclude the H4 close as future data yet keep H4 trend_20 (-82.76) as its strongest bearish evidence, and cannot claim 'uniform downtrend' while H4 trend_50 is +256.38. The down bias and its 0.52 confidence therefore rest on inconsistent contamination handling and cherry-picked horizons; the honest position at PIT was a much weaker, direction-unresolved call (RANGE or abstain) unless the contaminated bars are discarded and the case re-derived from completed bars only.
